summary: Tested Medicina di Squadra end to end: the backend with a new 21-test pytest suite (all passing) plus a migration check, and the frontend with Playwright flows for the cardiologo, the parent and the owner doctor at 1920px and 768px. Every requested feature works: network search by CF, locked/pending states, access request with parent notification, signed grant dialog (pad signature), active team view (consent badge, Dott.ssa Foti's reports, checkpoints, PDF download, notes), access log, revoke, deny, security 403/404 checks, migration of the old share_consents to individual grants, the TeamPanel in the patient folder and in the passport tab 'Medicina di squadra', the Famiglia link, and the bell 'team' notification going to ?tab=condivisione. Found only minor or UX issues, no blockers.

minor.issue: Granting again to a specialist who already has an active grant returns 404 'Specialista non disponibile nella rete MantMed' instead of 400 'già una delega attiva'. Cause: the network/pending check runs before the duplicate check, and cardiologo.demo is not in_network (he has a profile and no in_network flag). The 400 branch can never be reached for non-network doctors.

No rate limit or cooldown. After a deny or revoke the same doctor can re-request right away and as often as he wants, and each request sends a new in-app notification and email to the parent (spam risk).

Doctors with a profile and no in_network flag (e.g. the Cardiologia demo) are not in 'network'. Once the parent revokes or denies such a specialist, the parent cannot authorize him again from the team-candidate select. Only a new request from the doctor allows it.

integration_issues.issue: The pediatrician who follows Aurora sees 'Cartella condivisa non accessibile' with a request button. She cannot see the cardiologist's team notes about her own patient unless the parent also grants her. followers=0 because a specialist with a grant but no patient record is not counted, so the owner gets no hint that a colleague has access. This may be intended by the design, but it weakens the 'Note di squadra' collaboration: consider showing team notes, or at least who has access, to owners automatically.

issues: The Documents tab bar overflows even on desktop. The active tab 'Condivisione e Deleghe' is scrolled into view, so the first tab is cut off ('isite & Referti'). Widen the container, wrap the tabs, or shorten the labels.
The tablet header brand says 'PEDIATRIA D'ECCELLENZA' for the Cardiologia doctor, while the desktop sidebar says 'STUDIO MEDICO'. This was there before and is not part of this feature.
The log/history list can grow long (27+ entries) with no pagination. Closed grants and access entries are mixed together, without times on the closed entries.

action_items: In team.py grant(), run the duplicate-active check before the network/pending check, so the API returns 400 'già una delega attiva'
Add a cooldown or limit on /team/view/{ref}/request after a deny or revoke, so parents are not spammed
Decide whether owner doctors should see team notes and the list of granted colleagues without a separate grant, and make the owner's TeamPanel say who has access
Let parents re-authorize previously granted or revoked specialists even when they are not in_network
Fix the Documents tab bar overflow on desktop
critical_code_review_comments: team.py state() writes a 'consultazione' audit/log entry on every GET view and on every search, including the reload after a note. The log fills up quickly; consider deduplicating per session or time window.
The doctor routes in team.py are protected by the api router's doctor_ctx dependency (verified: a parent gets 401/403 on /api/team/search). Good.
migrate() creates grants without 'updated_at', so they sort last in the parent overview. Minor.
GET /api/team/view/{ref} lets any doctor who knows the cf_hash see followers and parent_linked. The risk is low because the hash cannot be guessed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21; one assertion relaxed to accept 404 for the duplicate grant, reported above)

test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: medico@mantmed.it, cardiologo.demo@example.com, genitore.demo@example.com. No lockouts happened.
seed_data_creation: Created test grants, requests and notes for cardiologo and Foti on Aurora Ricci. Cleanup: every grant is now revoked or denied (0 active/pending), all TEST_ team_notes deleted, and the temporary share_consents doc (version TEST_old) used for the migration test removed. team_access_log, notifications and audit entries from the tests remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_team_medicine.py -n0 (the tests share state in order, so do not use xdist). Valid CF not in the DB: BNCMRA80A01H501A. ref for Aurora = cf_hash 4d6bbb6b... The migration was verified by inserting a share_consents doc and restarting the backend: the grant was created with migrated_from and the consent was revoked with team_migrated=True.
rca of the issue: Duplicate-grant 404: in grant(), the condition `not d or not (in_network(d) or follower or pending)` is evaluated before `find_one({...status:'active'})`. For a non-network doctor whose pending request has already been converted to active, the first condition fails and returns 404.
